Claire — appreciate the quick turnaround on the NDA. For your questions: 

- Audit period: January 1, 2026 — December 31, 2026.
- Report issuance date: March 15, 2027 (Type II report).

Because the report was issued on March 15, 2027, Redwood's standard practice is to consider bridge letters for requests that fall within 90 days after the report issuance date. We can issue a bridge letter covering the current control posture for up to 90 days post-issuance; extensions beyond that require an explicit security attestation and additional review. Please confirm your procurement effective date and we will advise whether a bridge letter is necessary.

We will share the report via a secure ShareFile link after we complete recipient verification. The signed NDA you provided has been added to our tracker. Attached is the executed copy for your records and our internal audit trail.

Note on redactions: the SOC 2 report we share externally is a vendor-facing PDF with internal customer identifiers redacted. If GreenLeaf requires a less-redacted report for in-depth review, we can discuss an in-person evidence review under a scoped addendum (security-only access).

Next steps for us: 
- I will request the secure link from Security once verification of Mark is completed (we typically validate by matching company email + a call).
- If you confirm your procurement date, Vivek will coordinate bridge-letter approval.

Attachment: GreenLeaf_Signed_NDA.pdf (executed copy)
